# PleebUI

PleebUI is an integrated interface suite for World of Warcraft Retail, built for Midnight. It combines combat frames, action bars, cooldown tracking, class resources, damage meters, and interface tools in one configurable layout.

## Included

- Player, Target, Focus, Boss, Party, and Raid Unit Frames
- Configurable cast bars, portraits, text, dispels, threat indicators, and aura groups
- Action Bars with per-bar layouts, visibility rules, mouseover fading, Pet and Stance bars, and additional Bars 9-12
- Cooldown Manager styling with per-icon settings, Buff Bars, keybinds, colors, and glows
- Guided custom cooldown, duration, charge, and aura tracker creation
- Consumable Tracker for supported potions, Healthstones, combat resurrection items, trinkets, racials, and other combat items
- Personal Resource Display for health, primary power, class resources, and tracked effects
- Up to ten Damage Meter windows with breakdowns and encounter or Mythic+ history
- Chat, Minimap, Player Buffs, bags, Character and Inspect panel styling, and a Skyriding bar
- Edit Mode with Smart Snap, previews, Test Mode, profiles, and import/export
- Optional combat warnings, pet warnings, cursor ring, crosshair, raid utilities, and automation

## Start here

The setup wizard opens for new characters. Use `/pui` to open settings and `/pe` to position supported frames and bars.

Other commands include `/pek` for keyboard Edit Mode, `/test` as an alternate Edit Mode command, `/kb` for Action Bar binding mode, `/cd` for Blizzard Cooldown Manager settings, and `/dmg` for Damage Meters.

## Compatibility

- World of Warcraft Retail
- Midnight 12.1
- Required libraries are included

Source and issue tracker: [github.com/grimboso/PleebUI](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI)
